prompt:
SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: a POINT popup gem — a small golden arcade diamond coin-flash with a lit crown facet and dark outline, glowing. Warm gold #ffd040 / #d8a018 with white sparkle on black.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure BLACK background, exactly hex #000000, identical solid black in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no stars, no floor plane — this is ADDITIVE glow art: brightness is opacity, so everything visible sits on pure black and the dim halo fades smoothly INTO the black.
- EXACTLY 4 equal square cells laid out as FOUR cells as TWO rows of TWO (2-column by 2-row) — every cell holding exactly ONE subject; a missing, empty or merged cell ruins the entire sheet.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom): the SAME subject, squarish (width close to height), centred in its cell at the same scale — ONLY the named state changes between cells; the silhouette stays identical in all cells.
  cell 1 = full bright; cell 2 = shrinking step 1; cell 3 = dim smallest; cell 4 = recovering.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 512×512 px. Produce EXACTLY 4 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 30 px of unbroken flat #000000 around it and clean flat gutters between cells.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: retro 16-bit pixel art, chunky visible square pixels, flat saturated fills with a three-step shading ramp lit from the top-left, crisp 1-px near-black navy outline on every silhouette edge (outline only around the bright core, fading out in the halo), no anti-aliasing, no motion blur.
negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, labels, numbers, cell borders, guide lines, grid lines, watermark, blurry, anti-aliasing, gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, multiple subjects per cell, empty cell
label: GEN4 owner-waived never-designed slot items/point 4f sheet 512x512
